notes: Company SR265 'Kapoor E-Illuminations' (kapooreilluminations.com) refuses connections directly on port 443; port 80 301s -> http://kapoorlampshades.com -> https://kapoorlampshades.com (Cloudflare, 200). Same legal entity/storefront per prior Home-Decor pass notes/265.md -- extraction done on kapoorlampshades.com. Access tier 1 (plain HTTP fetch) worked throughout. Navigation discovery: /collections.json lists a single candidate with handle 'sale' (title on the collection page itself is just 'Sale', raw products_count=116). No 'clearance' or 'outlet' handle exists anywhere in the 31-collection list, so this is the only candidate. Sale-vs-Clearance judgment: the rendered collection page's own H1/title/meta-description only say 'Sale' / 'Shop Sale Lighting Products' with no permanence language (no 'outlet', 'final', 'last chance', 'end of line', 'discontinued') and the on-page copy is ordinary percent-off merchandising (e.g. 'Save 40%', 'Save 60%' on individual items) with no stated permanence -- by itself this would read as a generic promotional Sale page, normally excluded. HOWEVER the site's OWN main-navigation link text for this exact URL (https://kapoorlampshades.com/collections/sale) reads 'Clearance Sale', not just 'Sale' -- confirmed by parsing the homepage nav markup directly (href=/collections/sale, anchor text='Clearance Sale'). This matches the brief's test ('If the website's own taxonomy clearly treats the page as Clearance ... via nav label, it qualifies'). The prior Home-Decor pass (notes/265.md) independently recorded this same collection as 'sale/Clearance Sale (promotional, NEVER EXTRACT)' when excluding it from category counts, corroborating that the merchant's own nav labelling is 'Clearance Sale' for this URL. On balance I am recording it as Clearance (nav-label evidence is direct site taxonomy, stronger than the generic on-page H1 wording) but flagging it for human confirmation since the on-page content itself reads as an ordinary percent-off sale with no outlet/permanence language. Qty cross-check: exhaustive dedup paging of /collections/sale/products.json?limit=250 = 94 unique product ids; rendered page's own filter panel header reads 'Filter 94 products' -- both match exactly (raw collections.json products_count=116 is inflated, not used, consistent with prior pass's documented pattern for this site).
